summary: The ordinary /api/teaching/classes/[classId]/memberships/[membershipId]/approve POST route now rejects signed teacher cookies whose actorId or sessionId is not a safe server identity before membership approval writes can run.

redGreenEvidence.observed: The unsafe membership approval actorId case failed with HTTP 400 because a validly signed unsafe actor id reached later validation. The unsafe membership approval sessionId case failed with HTTP 200 because a validly signed unsafe session id allowed membership approval writes.

behaviorHardened: Signed membership approval cookies whose actorId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Signed membership approval cookies whose sessionId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Unsafe signed identity claims are rejected before membership approval writes, class/course student count updates, or approve-class-membership audit events can be written.
The denial responses preserve trace id and redaction without echoing unsafe local-path or secret-like identity values.
